verdict.rationale: Working Copy lets users attach an SSH private key to a saved 'Identity' that can live in the Secure Enclave and unlock via Face ID/Touch ID, so subsequent connections to that remote host don't require re-entering credentials — fitting the 'saved host, no re-entry' story for git-over-SSH remotes (including self-hosted GitHub Enterprise/GitLab/Gitea). However, the docs never explicitly describe a literal 'one tap to connect' flow or host list; it's inferred from identity/key persistence rather than an explicit saved-host quick-connect UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-tap saved-host connect action and independent hands-on confirmation of credential-free reconnection.
